content.title: How to watch Wisconsin vs High Point with Sling TV
content.text: BLOGSPORTSCOLLEGE BASKETBALLHOW TO WATCH WISCONSIN VS HIGH POINT WITH SLING TV#5 Wisconsin vs. #12 High Point Prediction, Odds, & How to Watch: March Madness® 2026#5 Wisconsin takes on #12 High Point at the Moda Center for a West Region matchup. Here are details, our prediction, and how to watch with Sling TV.The No. 5 seed Wisconsin Badgers head to Portland looking to reverse a history of early March Madness® exits at this seed line, having only advanced once in five previous tries as a #5 seed. They face a dangerous No. 12 seed High Point Panthers squad that enters the tournament with the longest active winning streak in Division I at 14 games. High Point boasts one of the most explosive offenses in the nation, ranking fourth in scoring at 90.0 points per game.To Watch the Badgers vs. Panthers First Round game with Sling, use the link below for a 1 Day Pass subscription to TBS or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Game DetailInformationMatchup#5 Wisconsin vs. #12 High PointDate / TimeThursday, March 19, 2026 | 1:50 PM ETLocationModa Center, Portland, ORChannelTBSWatch With Sling1, 3, & 7 Day Pass or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Opening SpreadWisconsin -10.5 (O/U 164.5)Wisconsin Badgers Analysis Season Overview: Wisconsin (24-7) enters the tournament playing its best basketball of the season, bolstered by eight Quad 1 wins and a strong finish in the Big Ten. Star Player: Nick Boyd (G). The senior guard leads the Badgers with 20.6 PPG and 4.2 APG, serving as the primary playmaker in an offense that has shifted to a much faster tempo than previous years. The X-Factor: Nolan Winter (F). Averaging 8.6 rebounds and 1.2 blocks, Winter's interior presence is vital to matching High Point's aggressive scoring at the rim. High Point Panthers Analysis Season Overview: The Panthers (30-4) dominated the Big South, featuring an elite offensive rating of 127.0 and a prolific transition attack. Star Player: Terry Anderson (F). The graduate student leads High Point with 16.0 PPG and 6.0 RPG, capable of scoring in bunches as shown by his 31-point high game this season. The Upset Formula: Turnover-Forcing Defense. High Point averages 10.9 steals per game. If they can force Wisconsin's typically disciplined backcourt into uncharacteristic mistakes, they can fuel their 90-point offense through transition. Key Matchup & Advanced Analytics Position Battle: Backcourt Tempo. Wisconsin’s Nick Boyd and John Blackwell match up against High Point’s Rob Martin and Conrad Martinez. While High Point ranks 24th nationally in possession length, Wisconsin has surged to 135th, indicating a high-scoring guard-heavy duel. Statistical Edge: High Point is top-20 nationally in both field goal percentage (49.1%) and true shooting (61.1%), but Wisconsin counters with a top-60 ranking in 2-point and 3-point percentage. Betting Trends: Wisconsin opened as a heavy favorite (up to -12.5), but early action on the popular "5-12 upset" narrative has moved the line toward -10.5 in some markets. Final Prediction & Betting Pick The Verdict: Wisconsin wins, though High Point's relentless scoring makes for a tense finish. Final Score Prediction: Wisconsin 87, High Point 78. Best Bet: Over 164.5. Frequently Asked Questions Who is the favorite in Wisconsin vs. High Point? Wisconsin is a 10.5-point favorite with a moneyline of -515.
